submission.justification: Absorber-F1 is recommended as the only viable choice based on available data. F3 is eliminated due to residual dose rate of 85 μSv/h, which exceeds the hard requirement of 20 μSv/h by more than 4x. Between F1 and F2 (both passing dose requirements), F1 provides superior radiation safety with a dose rate of only 6 μSv/h compared to F2's 12 μSv/h. This 2x safety margin is critical for hands-on maintenance and provides operational flexibility. A plate thickness of 6 mm is chosen as a mid-range value within the 2-10 mm constraint. Without simulation data available to compare energy resolution performance, the selection prioritizes the confirmed safety advantage of F1 while maintaining flexibility for optimization. The energy resolution requirement of 4.5% at 100 GeV remains to be validated through future simulation or prototype testing.
